pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, The Denial of Saint Peter — the servant naming the hunted man by candlelight while a hand points him out to the guards, when the Ziphites went to Saul and said is David not hiding among us
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_the_denial_of_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Peter in Prison — the old apostle sitting in the cell with his hands locked together and the keys lying on the straw, save me O God by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might, hear my prayer O God
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saint_peter_in_prison

pictures.scene: Jan van Huchtenburgh, Cavalry Battle — the rider charging in with his sword out over the men already down on the ground, listen to the words of my mouth, for strangers rise up against me
pictures.name: pd_van_huchtenburgh_cavalry_battle

pictures.scene: Salvator Rosa, Bandits on a Rocky Coast — the armed robbers waiting among the rocks above the road, and ruthless men seek my life, men with no regard for God
pictures.name: pd_rosa_bandits_on_a_rocky_coast

pictures.scene: Washington Allston, Elijah in the Desert — the raven bringing bread down to the worn-out prophet lying by the brook, Selah, surely God is my helper
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Bernhard Plockhorst, The Good Shepherd — the shepherd carrying the lamb on His arm and bringing the flock home over the stones, the Lord is the sustainer of my soul, He will reward my enemies with evil
pictures.name: pd_plockhorst_the_good_shepherd

pictures.scene: Follower of Rembrandt, The Sacrifice of Manoah — the man and his wife down on their knees with folded hands beside the offering, in Your faithfulness destroy them, freely I will sacrifice to You
pictures.name: pd_the_sacrifice_of_manoah

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Prophetess Anna — the old woman bent over the great open book with her hand laid on the page, I will praise Your name O LORD for it is good, for He has delivered me from every trouble
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_prophetess_anna

pictures.scene: Circle of Juan de la Corte, The Israelites Crossing the Red Sea — Pharaoh and his chariots going down in the water while the people stand safe on the far shore, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes
pictures.name: pd_de_la_corte_the_israelites_crossing_the_red_sea

lines.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?”
Save me, O God, by Your name,
and vindicate me by Your might!
listen to the words of my mouth.
For strangers rise up against me,
and ruthless men seek my life—
men with no regard for God.
the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
He will reward my enemies with evil.
Freely I will sacrifice to You;
I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
For He has delivered me from every trouble,
and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
